name: Arcing Weapon (Mythic)
body:
Your blasts become even more powerful when delivered through your weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Arcing Weapon.

Benefit(s): You can deliver a touch spell, a ray spell or a spell with a defined target or number of targets (rather than an area) through your weapon. Only a single target struck by your weapon is affected, even if the spell normally affects multiple targets.
